note: Statute of 15.10.2002, §2: "Założycielami Fundacji, zwanymi dalej fundatorami są: Gmina Wrocław oraz Wrocławskie Przedsiębiorstwo „Hala Ludowa” Sp. z o.o.". Its main activity runs on cooperation with the city.

name: FUNDUSZ GRANTOWY DLA PŁOCKA
owners: Gmina Miasto Płock (fundator, PLN 600,000 of the PLN 1 mln fund); PKN ORLEN S.A. (fundator, PLN 300,000); Basell Orlen Polyolefins sp. z o.o. (50/50 joint venture of ORLEN and LyondellBasell) (fundator, PLN 100,000)
note: Deed signed 15.12.2005 by the city, PKN ORLEN and Basell Orlen Polyolefins after a 2003 UNDP-backed partnership; ORLEN lists it among foundations where it holds a founding role. BOP is only half ORLEN-owned, so it counts as public under the any-stake rule but not under a majority test.

name: ZAKŁAD NARODOWY IM. OSSOLIŃSKICH (Wrocław)
owners: Rzeczpospolita Polska, by the Act of 5.01.1995 o fundacji - Zakład Narodowy imienia Ossolińskich (established the foundation by statute; the Minister Edukacji Narodowej issued its statute and registered it); Minister właściwy ds. kultury i ochrony dziedzictwa narodowego (supervisor)
note: Art. 1 of the act: "Ustanawia się fundację pod nazwą Zakład Narodowy imienia Ossolińskich", under the President's patronage, endowed with the former PAN library's assets and funded by state budget grants; its organs are the Rada Kuratorów (13 members) and the Dyrektor. The culture minister supervises it, can suspend the Dyrektor and install a temporary manager, and must agree to statute changes; which bodies nominate the Rada Kuratorów is set in the statute, which was not checked.

name: FUNDACJA INTELIGENTNA MAŁOPOLSKA (Kraków)
owners: Małopolska Agencja Rozwoju Regionalnego S.A. (MARR) (fundator)
note: MARR's press release of 01.07.2019 says FabLab Małopolska is run by "Fundację Inteligentna Małopolska, której fundatorem jest MARR" (seen as a search quote, the PDF host did not resolve), and the foundation (registered 04.05.2018) sits at MARR's office, ul. Kordylewskiego 11, Kraków. MARR is controlled by Województwo Małopolskie (88.8% in NIK's 2016 audit, not re-checked).

name: REVITA (Płock)
owners: Agencja Rewitalizacji Starówki ARS sp. z o.o. (Gmina Miasto Płock; the Prezydent Miasta Płocka exercises its shareholders' meeting rights) (fundator)
note: rejestr.io (seen only as a search snippet, the page returns 403) records the Prezydent Miasta Płocka, acting as the shareholders' meeting of ARS sp. z o.o., as "fundator fundacji"; the KRS gives the foundation the e-mail fundacja.revita@ars.plock.pl, and the city's 2025 revitalisation report shows ARS and Revita running Stary Rynek events together. Registered 08.10.2014.

name: FUNDACJA ENEA - ENERGIA WSPÓLNOTY (Poznań)
owners: Enea S.A. (fundator (inferred, not named in any source found))
note: Registered in March 2025 at ul. Pastelowa 8, Poznań (Enea S.A.'s head office) and started work that month, while Enea S.A.'s board wound down the older Fundacja Enea (KRS 0000505487, resolutions 219/2025 and 220/2025 of 05.08.2025); Enea's CEO spoke at its first partners' meeting. No document naming the fundator was found, so Enea S.A. (or another Enea group company) as founder is an inference.

name: FUNDACJA UZDROWISKA SZCZAWNO - JEDLINA S.A. "STOKROTKA" W LIKWIDACJI (Szczawno-Zdrój)
owners: Uzdrowisko Szczawno-Jedlina S.A. (sole shareholder: Województwo Dolnośląskie) (fundator (inferred))
note: Registered 16.11.2015 under the spa company's name, at its addresses (ul. Sienkiewicza, then ul. Wojska Polskiego 6) and with its e-mail domain szczawno-jedlina.pl; liquidation opened 15.02.2024 and it was struck off KRS on 19.02.2026. The spa company's KRS lists "WOJEWÓDZTWO DOLNOŚLĄSKIE - MARSZAŁEK WOJEWÓDZTWA DOLNOŚLĄSKIEGO" as sole shareholder (capital PLN 92.6 mln); no document naming the fundator was found.

name: FUNDACJA PGE ENERGIA CIEPŁA (Rybnik)
owners: PGE Energia Ciepła S.A. (PGE group; legal successor of EDF Polska S.A. and Elektrownia Rybnik S.A.) (holder of the founder's rights 2017-2021 (inferred); PGE calls it one of its two corporate foundations)
note: KRS name history: FUNDACJA ELEKTROWNI RYBNIK (registered 28.04.2004, ul. Podmiejska 43, Rybnik) -> FUNDACJA EDF POLSKA -> FUNDACJA PGE ENERGIA CIEPŁA, struck off 21.07.2021 after a merger; PGE's 2019 integrated report names it one of the group's two corporate foundations. No source names the fundator, so the founder is inferred from the name, and before PGE bought EDF's Polish assets in 2017 the plant company was in the EDF group (any remaining Skarb Państwa stake in 2004 was not checked).

name: PODLASKA FUNDACJA ROZWOJU REGIONALNEGO (Białystok)
owners: Wojewoda Białostocki (government administration) (institutional fundator); private co-founders: Izba Przemysłowo-Handlowa w Białymstoku, NSZZ "Solidarność" Region Białystok, Podlasko-Mazurskie Porozumienie Związków Zawodowych
note: Set up in September 1994 on the initiative of the Polish and British governments, by four institutional founders of which only the voivode is a public body. Public by the decision on 2026-11-19 (any public founder counts).

name: FUNDACJA ROZWOJU OŚRODKA AKADEMICKIEGO (Rzeszów)
owners: Wojewoda Rzeszowski (Skarb Państwa), Gmina Miasta Rzeszowa (council resolution XLV/16/93), Politechnika Rzeszowska, Wyższa Szkoła Pedagogiczna w Rzeszowie, the Rzeszów branches of UMCS and Akademia Rolnicza w Krakowie, Sejmik Samorządowy Województwa Rzeszowskiego (founders); private co-founders: Diecezja Rzeszowska and an MP
note: Notarial deed of 23.03.1993, signed by the office-holders of these bodies, to build the case for Uniwersytet Rzeszowski; its Rada Fundatorów has since been filled by the sitting mayor, voivode, marshal and rectors. Public by the decision on 2026-11-19 (any public founder counts).

name: FUNDACJA OCHRONY WIELKICH JEZIOR MAZURSKICH (Giżycko)
